title: What's your conflict style?
intro: Nine questions about small disagreements, from group chats to the last slice of pizza. We'll show you how you handle friction, and what mix of styles you bring to the table.

outcomes.name: The Straight Shooter
outcomes.tagline: Say it plainly, sort it quickly, move on.
outcomes.description: You'd rather have an awkward five minutes than a tense five weeks. You name the problem, say where you stand and expect others to do the same. People always know where they are with you, and that honesty is a gift, even when it arrives a little fast.

outcomes.name: The Bridge Builder
outcomes.tagline: Not your side or mine: let's find a better one.
outcomes.description: You treat a disagreement like a puzzle that both people are solving together. You ask questions, you listen for what someone actually needs, and you keep going until everyone walks away feeling heard. It takes longer, and the results tend to last.

outcomes.name: The Peacekeeper
outcomes.tagline: Keeping the room warm is your quiet superpower.
outcomes.description: You notice when someone is upset before they've said a word, and you'll happily give a little ground to keep things kind. Friends feel safe around you. Just remember your own wishes count too: the people who love you want to hear them.

outcomes.name: The Dealmaker
outcomes.tagline: Half each, shake on it, let's get dinner.
outcomes.description: You're practical about disagreements: everyone gives a bit, everyone gets a bit, and nobody spends the whole evening arguing. You're brilliant at spotting the reasonable middle and talking people towards it. Group trips run smoother with you in charge of the plan.

outcomes.name: The Cool Head
outcomes.tagline: Step back, breathe, then come back wiser.
outcomes.description: You know that not every argument needs to happen right now. You take a walk, let the heat drain out, and return when you can say what you actually mean. Plenty of fights simply dissolve on their own while you're away, and the ones that don't go far better.

outcomes.name: The Tension Breaker
outcomes.tagline: One well-timed joke and everyone exhales.
outcomes.description: You have a knack for finding the funny side just when the room needs it most. A light word from you lowers shoulders and reminds everyone they actually like each other. Once people are laughing again, the real conversation tends to get a lot easier.

questions.text: Your housemate keeps leaving dishes in the sink. You…

answers.text: Mention it the next time you see them
Suggest a rota you can both live with
Wash them yourself, just this once
Stick a googly-eyed note on the pile
Leave it until you're less annoyed

questions.text: Your friends can't agree on where to eat. You…

answers.text: Pick a place and book it
Ask what everyone's in the mood for
Suggest one place now and another next week
Stay out of it until there's a shortlist
Nominate the worst restaurant in town

questions.text: Pick a superpower for an argument.
There's one slice of pizza left and you and a friend both want it. You…

answers.text: Make a dramatic speech for it

questions.text: A friend cancels on you last minute for the third time. You feel…
Which of these sounds most like you mid-disagreement?

answers.text: "What if we each give a little?"

questions.text: Someone gives you feedback you don't agree with. You…

answers.text: Ask what they meant by it
Take on the parts that are fair
Think it over for a day

questions.text: After a disagreement is over, what matters most to you?

answers.text: That you understand each other better
That everyone can laugh about it
That nobody said anything they'll regret
